# Command line

```
pv-geom [--quiet | --verbose] COMMAND [OPTIONS]
```

## `pv-geom compare-reference`

Compare measured geometry with externally reported geometry (e.g. PVDAQ).

| | | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OUTPUT_URI` | argument | A finished run's output. |
| `--reference`, `-r` | required | Table of reference mounts (CSV or Parquet). |
| `--out` | option | Directory for the result tables. |
| `--tilt-tolerance` | option | Tilt agreement tolerance, degrees. Default: `3.0`. |
| `--azimuth-tolerance` | option | Azimuth agreement tolerance, degrees. Default: `10.0`. |

## `pv-geom demo`

Generate a small synthetic study area and run the whole pipeline on it.

Needs no data and no network: fifteen arrays with known tilt and
orientation are written as a LAZ tile and a polygon layer, measured, and
reported. A quick way to see every output, and to check an installation.

| | | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--out` | option | Where to write the demo Default: `pv_geom_demo`. |

## `pv-geom describe-output`

Summarise a finished run: counts, vintage, geometry basis, fit quality.

| | | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OUTPUT_URI` | argument |  |

## `pv-geom inspect-tile`

Vet a LiDAR source: classes present, density, CRS, units, flight dates.

| | | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TILE` | argument | One LAZ tile (path or s3://) |
| `--json` | option | Print JSON instead of a table |

## `pv-geom report`

Build tables, figures, an HTML/Markdown report and the release dataset
from a finished run; or, with --compare, set several runs side by side.

| | | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OUTPUT_URIS` | argument | A pv-geom output directory or s3:// prefix (several with --compare) |
| `--out` | option | Where to write the report. Default: <output>/report (local outputs) |
| `--compare` | option | Compare the given runs side by side instead of reporting on one (needs --out) |
| `--label` | option | With --compare: a name for each run, in order (default: study.name from each run's config) |
| `--regions` | option | Polygon layer of regions (districts, municipalities) for a per-region table and map |
| `--region-col` | option | Column of the region layer holding the region names |
| `--title` | option | Report title |
| `--area-name` | option | Name of the study area, used in titles and the methods text (default: study.name from the run's config) |
| `--headline` | option | Stratum the report leads with: panel, all_fitted, surface_unresolved or unscreened (default: panel when there is enough of it) |
| `--weight` | option | Weighting of the headline figures: area (array surface) or count Default: `area`. |
| `--export`, `--no-export` | option | Also write the consolidated dataset (GeoParquet + CSV + data dictionary) Default: `True`. |
| `--polygon-vintage` | option | Polygon vintage, for outputs written without one (pre-0.2.0) |
| `--lidar-date` | option | LiDAR date, for outputs written without one (pre-0.2.0) |

## `pv-geom reproduce`

Rerun a finished run from its manifest and check the result is the same.

| | | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OUTPUT_URI` | argument | A finished run's output. |
| `--out` | required | Where to write the rerun. |
| `--local` | option | Use a local Dask cluster (default: serial). |
| `--tolerance` | option | How far numbers may differ (degrees, metres) and still count as reproduced. On the same machine the result is bit-for-bit; across platforms the last bits of a float differ. Default: `0.0001`. |

## `pv-geom run`

Measure every polygon against the LiDAR and write the dataset.

| | | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | option | YAML config. Its `inputs` and `study` blocks can name everything below; options given here override it |
| `--polygons` | option | PV polygon layer: GeoParquet / GPKG / GeoJSON / SHP (path or s3://) |
| `--lidar-prefix` | option | Directory or S3 prefix holding the LAZ tiles |
| `--tile-index` | option | LiDAR tile index: GeoParquet/GPKG/SHP/.zip. Default: read from tile headers |
| `--output` | option | Output directory or s3:// prefix |
| `--polygon-vintage` | option | When the polygons' source imagery was captured: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD |
| `--polygon-vintage-col` | option | Per-polygon capture-date column in the polygon layer |
| `--lidar-date` | option | LiDAR capture date (same formats). Omit to measure it from the tiles' GPS time |
| `--footprints` | option | Optional building footprints (GeoParquet/GPKG/SHP) |
| `--crs` | option | Run CRS (the LiDAR's metric CRS). Default: taken from the tile index |
| `--polygon-id-col` | option | Id column in the polygon layer. Default: auto-detect, else synthesize |
| `--local`, `--no-local` | option | Force compute.backend=local |
| `--max-polygons` | option | Limit polygon count (dev/smoke) |
| `--bbox` | option | Restrict to bbox in run-CRS units: xmin ymin xmax ymax |
| `--dry-run`, `--no-dry-run` | option | Plan + vintage check only; no compute |
| `--resume`, `--no-resume` | option | Keep partitions already at the output and run the rest. Refused if they were made from different inputs, settings or schema. |
| `--force-resume`, `--no-force-resume` | option | Resume even if the existing partitions were made from different inputs, settings or schema |
| `--name-template` | option | LAZ filename template using {name} from the tile index id column (default {name}.laz) |
| `--tile-id-col` | option | Tile-id column in the tile index. Default: auto-detect |
| `--no-dask`, `--no-no-dask` | option | Run serially instead of via Dask |
| `--report`, `--no-report` | option | Build the report (tables, figures, HTML) after a local run Default: `True`. |

## `pv-geom validate-config`

Validate a YAML config and show what a run from it would use.

| | | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONFIG` | argument |  |

## `pv-geom verify`

Check that an output is what its manifest says it is, or how it differs
from another run of the same inputs.

| | | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OUTPUT_URI` | argument | A finished run's output. |
| `--against` | option | Another output to compare with, row by row. |
| `--tolerance` | option | With --against: how far numbers may differ (degrees, metres) and still count as the same result. Use 0 to demand bit-for-bit. Default: `0.0001`. |

## `pv-geom version`

Print the package version.
